managePayments.keyMismatch.title: The Stripe keys do not match
managePayments.keyMismatch.body: This site’s server is using the Stripe key for the {server, select, live {real} other {test}} environment, while the browser was built with the key for the {browser, select, live {real} other {test}} environment. Card payments would fail exactly when a customer tries to pay, so Stripe setup is blocked until they match.
managePayments.keyMismatch.fix: Both keys must be for the same environment and the site must be rebuilt afterwards — the public key is baked in at build time, while the secret key is read on every request.

customDomain.providers.godaddy.caveat: If you added more than one at once, the button says “Save All Records”.
customDomain.providers.123reg.signIn: Log in to the “123 Reg Control Panel”.
customDomain.providers.123reg.manage: Beside “Domains”, select “Manage All”, then choose your web address.
customDomain.providers.123reg.name: Put the first value below in “Name”.
customDomain.providers.123reg.value: Put the second value below in “Value” and add a full stop at its end.
customDomain.providers.123reg.caveat: 123 Reg needs a full stop at the end of the second value, otherwise it will not work.
customDomain.providers.wix.open: Open “Domains”, then click the “Domain Actions” icon beside your web address.
customDomain.providers.wix.add: In the “CNAME (Aliases)” section, click “+ Add Record”, then click “Got it”.
customDomain.providers.wix.name: Put the first value below in “Host Name”.
customDomain.providers.wix.value: Put the second value below in “Value”.
customDomain.providers.wix.save: Click “Save”, then click “Save Changes” in the window that opens.
customDomain.providers.wix.caveat: If your web address only points at Wix and is not held there, Wix cannot make this change — whoever holds it must do it.
customDomain.instructionsEmail.subject: One DNS record to add — schedule page: {truckName}
customDomain.instructionsEmail.introAt: We are putting the up-to-date schedule of the food truck {truckName} on {address} and for this one record needs adding to our domain at {provider}.
customDomain.instructionsEmail.introHold: We are putting the up-to-date schedule of the food truck {truckName} on {address} and for this one record needs adding to our domain by whoever holds our domain.
customDomain.instructionsEmail.wholeChan: That is the whole change — nothing else on the website is affected and the rest of our domain keeps working exactly as now. It usually starts working within an hour.
customDomain.instructionsEmail.pointsAt: The page it points at shows where we will trade next and updates itself.
customDomain.instructionsEmail.replyTo: Reply to {email} if you have questions.
customDomain.liveEmail.subject: {address} is working
customDomain.liveEmail.body: Your schedule now shows at your address. Have a look at it and check it is right: open {address}, make sure the events are yours and that the dates look correct.
customDomain.liveEmail.confirm: Once you have done it, open your settings on HatchGrab and tell us it is right. Nothing depends on this — it just tells us a person has seen it.
